name: Spam Comment Remover
author: Sahil Dadwal

sections.description:
🚀 Spam Comment Remover keeps your WordPress site clean and fast by automatically deleting all spam 🗑️ and pending ⏳ comments, while keeping approved comments 💬 completely safe.

✨ Key Features:
* 🧹 Auto-Cleanup – Deletes spam and pending comments automatically
* 🔒 Safe Mode – Approved comments are never deleted
* ⚡ Instant Cleanup – Deletes existing spam & pending comments immediately after activation
* 🚫 Spam Blocker – Stops spam comments before they’re even added
* 🪶 Lightweight – No bloat, works quietly in the background
* ☕ Support the developer with a coffee link

Perfect for bloggers, store owners, and anyone tired of manually removing spam. 💪
sections.installation:
1️⃣ Upload spam-comment-remover to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
2️⃣ Activate the plugin from WordPress Admin → Plugins.
3️⃣ Clear your cache for instant results.
sections.faq:
❓ Will approved comments be deleted?

No. ✅ Only spam and pending comments are removed.

⏱️ When are spam comments deleted?

They are removed automatically on every site load.

🤝 Does it work with other spam plugins?

Yes, it works alongside Akismet, Antispam Bee, and others.
